_doc: Information-coverage rubric for RQ4, fixed before scoring (applies to the current XFAIR-MED v2 outputs). Items are review-relevant conditions recorded in the toolkit's own outputs: low-support subgroups (frozen eligibility manifest), attributes without pairwise parity, explanation-scope declarations, provenance claims/gates, and uncertainty-method declarations. A field counts as present for conditions A and B only if a concrete artifact supplies it; condition C is scored from the checker's findings (a field is present only if the finding carries it and every evidence reference resolves to a declared artifact). A and B were not designed to carry fields f4-f6, so the comparison is descriptive.

fields.f2: affected metric or supporting evidence artifact
fields.f6: stable reference to evidence snapshot / reassessment
